explanation: Alspach's conjecture (proved by Bryant–Horsley–Pettersson 2014): for odd n and lengths 3 ≤ m_i ≤ n summing to C(n,2), K_n decomposes into cycles of those lengths. A cycle decomposition means every edge lies on exactly one cycle; cycles' edges are automatically graph edges. The multiset of lengths must match exactly. The statement is faithful to Wikipedia.
